messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment attempt to prod-canary started for tag v2.4.0-rc3 (commit 8f3d2b76)

deploy-bot: CI gate failed: 1/5 checks failed -> integration-tests (executor-42). Blocking rollout.

zoe: saw this. logs show a single failing test in model-compat: kvcache_leak_test

matt: linking logs: https://ci.company/exec/42/logs

sara: quick look: stacktrace shows OOM at kvcache eviction on large-sequence test, reproducible locally on my machine with --seq 8192

oncall-infra: is this new from the quantization change in rc3?

zoe: possibly. rc3 introduced int8-reorder in attention kernels. I can try a local run with rc2 binary to compare

release-manager: options: 1) revert to v2.4.0-rc2 and pin canary, 2) rerun only the integration job, 3) roll forward with hotfix patch branch. thoughts?

matt: we should rerun the failing job first (maybe flake). If it fails again, pin to rc2 to avoid blocking customers.

sara: +1. I'll trigger a rerun and attach repro gist if it fails.

deploy-bot: Rerun requested by sara. Re-queueing integration-tests (executor-43).

deploy-bot: Re-run finished: integration-tests FAILED again (executor-43). Failure consistent.

zoe: ok confirmed. reproduces locally. I'll open a tiny patch to guard kvcache eviction on oversized sequences. ETA ~30m

release-manager: schedule: canary pause, don't promote until fix merged and CI passes. I'll pin canary to v2.4.0-rc2 and update release notes channel.

oncall-infra: tagging oncall for priority review if the fix changes kernel memory layout: @oncall-infra please confirm no infra-level rollback needed

oncall-infra: acknowledged, will monitor. if patch touches allocator flags we may need a restart window.

sara: patch PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4892 added. running full CI on PR.

deploy-bot: PR CI started for PR #4892

matt: if PR CI green, we plan to promote rc3 once integration-tests pass on canary. If not green, we'll cut RC3-hotfix and rerun.

release-manager: noted. updating change window: hold promotion for 2 hours. I'll notify stakeholders.

zoe: thanks all, I'll follow up here with test results.
